name: Unitary Fund
description: Unitary Foundation is a 501(c)(3) non-profit that supports the quantum technology open-source ecosystem through microgrants, community building, and tool development. Its microgrant programme has awarded over 100 grants to individuals worldwide, producing more than 40 open-source libraries with 400+ contributors across projects including error mitigation, quantum programming, and open hardware.

news.title: Celebrating a Milestone: Over 100 Microgrants Awarded by Unitary Fund
news.excerpt: The Unitary Fund's microgrant program marked a milestone of over 100 microgrants awarded, resulting in 40+ open-source libraries with 400+ contributors and 420+ papers citing the research. The grants have spawned 3 startups and 1 non-profit.

news.title: Unitary Foundation and Riverlane Launch Deltakit Community Fund for Open-Source QEC Development
news.excerpt: Riverlane and the Unitary Foundation launched the Deltakit Community Fund on July 28, 2026 — a rolling quarterly microgrant program ($2,000–$4,000 per project) for external developers building features for Riverlane's open-source Deltakit QEC SDK. First review cohort deadline: August 17, 2026.
